'''2012 Yavin 4 Regionals Greg Shaw LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2012 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Infiltration|VB8-L-infiltration-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
